description:
Clear the current pixel selection. Pixels are unchanged.

Use when: a selection should be cleared before the next edit.
Do NOT use when: you want the inverse region selected — use photoshop_invert_selection.
Do NOT use when: you want every pixel selected — use photoshop_select_all.

Returns: confirmation that the selection was cleared.
Preconditions: active document. Safe when nothing is selected. Side effects: selection only. Idempotent. Reversible with photoshop_undo if a selection existed.

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

name: photoshop_deselect
